title: Parts from before the release are active and tracked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use three parts, part A, part B and part C, that were at the test location before this release was installed and that nobody has changed since.
  • Use a part B that has stock on hand and a saved Min and Max, so its tracking can be seen in its window.
  • Have an inactive part, part D, at the test location, so the Inactive tab has a part it must list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Replace the search text with part B's part number.
  3. Replace the search text with part C's part number.
  4. Click the Inactive tab.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Replace the search text with part B's part number.
  7. Replace the search text with part C's part number.
  8. Replace the search text with part D's part number.
  9. Click the Active tab.
  10. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  11. Click the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed on the Active tab.
  • Its Total Qty cell shows a quantity, not "Not Tracked".

Step 2:

  • Part B is listed on the Active tab.
  • Its Total Qty cell shows a quantity, not "Not Tracked".

Step 3:

  • Part C is listed on the Active tab.
  • Its Total Qty cell shows a quantity, not "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 5:

  • Part A is not listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 6:

  • Part B is not listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 7:

  • Part C is not listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 8:

  • Part D is listed on the Inactive tab: the search there works.

Step 9:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 10:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 11:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with a green "Active" pill in the title row.
  • Part Status is set to Active.
  • The "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch is on.
  • Min and Max show the values part B had before the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S1-R5: “Every part that exists on the day of release is active.”
  • S1-R5a: “Every part that exists on the day of release is tracked.”
  • Story 1, context note: “Context note: S1-R5 describes the data on release day, not a rule the system keeps enforcing. Nothing makes a part active again on its own.”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
